title: 5-Ingredient Meatloaf (No Breadcrumbs)
intro: This is such an easy recipe, and so quick to prepare. And with no breadcrumbs for those of you who are GMO intolerant makes this recipe a go to on most everyone's list.
ingredients: ⅓ cup Ketchup ⅓ BBQ sauce for spreading on top of loaf
steps: Preheat oven to 400 degrees F. Coat a loaf pan with olive oil
Mix all ingredients (except the ⅓ cup Ketchup ⅓ BBQ sauce reserved for the top) together in a large bowl with a fork or with hands: beef, parmesan cheese, onion, egg, salt, pepper.
Form a loaf in the loaf pan. Spread the Ketchup/BBQ sauce over the top of the meatloaf. Bake in the oven for 45 minutes.
